locator.section: In Octava Nativitatis Domini, Graduale Ps. 97, 3-4 et 2

entries.claim: The Mass of the Octave Day prints this Gradual in full. Its letters and accents equal page 21 and the selected text; it has a semicolon after nostri (Dei nostri; iubiláte) and no comma after Deo (iubiláte Deo omnis terra), where page 21 and the selected text have nostri: and Deo, omnis terra, and its label reads Ps. 97, 3-4 et 2 where page 21 has Ps. 97, 3 et 2.
The cited page image prints and identifies the complete 1962 liturgical component selected here; shared expansions are bounded in the witness record.
